plugins.name: katax-skills
plugins.description: The katax standard for Node.js/TypeScript APIs: skills with references and copy-ready templates (katax-core 1.6.7, katax-cli 1.7.1, katax-service-manager, MCP + OAuth 2.1, concurrency, security, uploads, Redis rate limiting), the katax-project-builder agent (create, extend, audit and migrate APIs, also as /katax-new-api, /katax-add-resource, /katax-audit-api) and katax-audit hooks.
